learning_objective: 🎯 Let's step into the world of 3D art by learning how to stack, balance, and build amazing sculptures and tall towers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: While a drawing is flat on paper (2D), a sculpture is 3D! This means it has height, width, and depth, so you can walk all the way around it to see every side.
To build something tall without it falling over, we need balance. A wide, heavy base keeps our structure safe and sturdy, just like the roots of a giant tree.
We can build using loose parts like wooden blocks, or we can connect things permanently using glue, clay, or tape to create an incredible permanent masterpiece.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Cardboard Castle Challenge!
fun_activity.instructions: Collect old toilet paper rolls, small boxes, and bottle caps. Use glue to stack and balance them into a giant, futuristic castle, then paint it with bright colors!

quick_recap: ⭐ 3D art like sculptures can be viewed from all different sides and angles.
⭐ A strong base and good balance keep tall structures from tumbling down.
⭐ We can recycle everyday boxes and blocks into magnificent architectural art.
